name: chartroom
description: chartroom: run a crew of coding agents from one agent session

plugins.name: chartroom
plugins.description: The chartroom and bearings skills. The plugin ships the skills; put the chartroom CLI on PATH with install.sh (or call bin/chartroom from the plugin directory).

plugins.name: crew-view
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: the crew live in the XO's session, a band above the prompt and a /crew pane that browses the items (detail, /continue, copy id, PRs and artifacts, the report), the focus and its held count while focus mode is on, and the commander's todo list under it with a /todo pane (copy, continue, tick off). Inert in every other session.
